# Ellis Services — Canberraroofkind

Canberraroofkind is the Canberra, ACT roofing enquiry website operated by Ellis Services. The site provides information about roof repair enquiry pathways for Canberra customers.

## Contact
- Address: 121 Marcus Clarke St, Canberra, ACT 2600, Australia
- Phone: +61 405 878 406
- Email: elliservices.group@gmail.com

## Service information
- Roof leak repair enquiries
- Tile roof repair enquiries
- Chimney flashing repair enquiries
- Rebedding and repointing enquiries
- Roof inspection enquiries
